metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-gn[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Snoozed task beads and a per-tab notification indicator[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A task bead can be snoozed with a wake time, an optional +1 target,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and a reason that every SASE surface displays; snoozing a task bead[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]always snoozes its notification; the wake raises a gate whose [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]primary action closes the bead with an overridable preset reason; [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and the top-bar notification indicator shows one accurately colored[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]count per notification-panel tab, with a snoozed count that appears[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]only when nothing else is pending, a rich hover briefing, and a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]structural guarantee that no notification can appear in two tabs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]bead_snooze_and_notification_indicator.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/bead_snooze_and_notification_indicator.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-gn[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-gn/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One tab per notification, counted in the core[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]notif-tab-model[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]notif-tab-model: make tab ownership a single-valued core rule that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]splits Snoozed from Muted, publish ordered per-tab counts on the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notification snapshot, and reduce the Python tag helpers to a thin [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]adapter.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Notification tab colors from senders and config[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]notif-tab-style[dim] · [dim][/dim]after notif-tab-model[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]notif-tab-style: add an optional sender-declared notification color, an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ace.notification_tabs config block, and a deterministic resolver that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gives every tab a stable accessible color.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Per-tab notification indicator and hover briefing[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]notif-indicator[dim] · [dim][/dim]after notif-tab-style[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]notif-indicator: render one colored count per panel tab with the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snoozed-only "<N>z" rule, bounded overflow, and a multi-line tooltip [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]briefing, wired through every existing indicator refresh path.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Snoozed task bead status in the Rust core[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bead-snooze-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bead-snooze-core: add the snoozed status, its embedded snooze record, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snooze/cancel mutations, +1 target wake, and time-based wake selection [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to the bead store, then mirror the model and presentation in Python.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase bead snooze and snooze-aware detail surfaces[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bead-snooze-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bead-snooze-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bead-snooze-cli: add the snooze command and its time, +1, and reason [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]arguments, extend status filters and query tokens, and show snooze [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]metadata everywhere bead detail is rendered.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]BeadSnooze wake gate[/bold #D7AFFF]                                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]snooze-wake-gate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bead-snooze-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]snooze-wake-gate: register the bead_snooze gate kind with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]close-primary, ready and re-snooze secondaries, and let a gate be born [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]already snoozed so the wake needs no second timer.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One pending gate per task bead[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]snooze-gate-reconciler[dim] · [dim][/dim]after snooze-wake-gate[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]snooze-gate-reconciler: extend the bead task-gate chop to own triage and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wake gates together, keep each snoozed bead's notification snoozed to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]its wake time, and add triage-time snoozing to the TaskTriage gate.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Snoozing from ACE, Telegram, and mobile[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bead-snooze-surfaces[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bead-snooze-cli, snooze-gate-reconciler[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bead-snooze-surfaces: add an ACE Beads-pane snooze action with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bead-aware duration modal, and confirm the Telegram and mobile gate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]paths carry the new options and metadata.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Cross-surface verification and documentation[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]snooze-verification[dim] · [dim][/dim]after notif-indicator, bead-snooze-surfaces[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]snooze-verification: exercise the whole snooze lifecycle and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]indicator end to end, check both repositories' gates, update user [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]documentation, and record the memory updates that need owner approval.[/#D7D7AF]
